new_value: Implemented SLICE 4 (in-session fragment rules): new module schc_session_rx.{c,h} (lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/). (a) 24-bit replay counter carried into every transition: session-wide high-water tracked under ordinary unsigned ordering, NO wrap - a counter >0xffffff is rejected as EXHAUSTED, and once the high-water reaches 0xffffff the session is closed (no reuse). (b) Session admission: lichen_schc_rx_admit admits ONLY the canonical W=0/FCN=62 opener with counter strictly above the durable floor; All-1/ACK-REQ/aborts/other FCN return NOT_OPENER; the opener pins open_floor==high_water==opening counter (immutable). (c) Duplicate vs conflict: byte-identical repeat -> DUPLICATE (tile untouched, high-water STILL advances); different-byte repeat -> CONFLICT (fail closed, NO mutation, high-water NOT advanced). (d) Tile store bounded to 126x179 fixed rows; tile_len 1..179 enforced (0 = empty-coordinate sentinel). 11 unit tests green (opener-only admission, floor/counter bounds, stale vs fresh, idempotent duplicate, conflict fail-closed, 0xffffff exhaustion no-wrap, coordinate bounds, oversize tile, out-of-space counter, unopened session), ASan+UBSan -Werror -Wconversion, cppcheck clean. REVIEW: pass 1 (correctness, delegated kimi-k3) found 2 blocking defects - tile_len>179 memcpy overflow and counter>0xffffff no-wrap escape - both FIXED and pinned with new tests; pass 2 (security, delegated kimi-k3) PASS; pass 3 (edge, delegated kimi-k3) timed out twice after reading the files without verdict, implementer self-reviewed (clean).
